title: Glass Cannon in a Stone World
goal: Cross the treacherous Iron Peaks to reach the trade hub of Oakhaven before his 'Newbie Protection' buff expires.
stakes_shift: Environmental hazards introduce threats that cannot be 'critically hit' or easily dodged.

bridge.from_prev: Artie leaves the tutorial zone with a unique title and a massive target on his back.
bridge.to_next: Artie arrives at Oakhaven only to find the gates barred to anyone without a guild voucher.

sections.title: Into the Iron Peaks
sections.intent: Transition from the safe tutorial zone to the high-stakes open world.
sections.end_condition: Artie crosses the threshold into the Iron Peaks territory.

scenes.summary: Artie travels to the edge of the starter zone.
scenes.outcome: Artie leaves the safety of the tutorial area.
scenes.transition_in_text: The lush greenery of the starter zone gives way to the jagged, rust-colored peaks of the Iron Range.
scenes.transition_out_text: A massive stone archway marks the boundary where the tutorial level ends and the real game begins.

scenes.summary: Artie encounters a group of high-level players camping the border.
scenes.outcome: Artie uses his new gear to outrun the players.
scenes.transition_in_text: Three players in heavy plate armor stand across the path, their weapons drawn and eyes fixed on Artie's unique gear.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie blurs into motion, his new boots kicking up a cloud of dust as he zips past the startled warriors.

scenes.summary: Transition handoff from The Iron Peaks Border to The Iron Peaks Border.
scenes.outcome: The handoff is concretely realized and constraints are carried forward.
scenes.transition_in_text: After a arrival checkpoint, the movement from The Iron Peaks Border to The Iron Peaks Border is realized on page.
scenes.transition_out_text: This beat pushes into a arrival checkpoint toward The Iron Peaks Border.

scenes.summary: Artie crosses into the Iron Peaks.
scenes.outcome: Artie successfully enters the new zone.
scenes.transition_in_text: The air temperature drops sharply as Artie steps past the stone archway and into the shadow of the mountains.
scenes.transition_out_text: The notification for the Iron Peaks zone appears, along with a warning about environmental damage.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie crosses the threshold into the Iron Peaks territory.

sections.title: Environmental Hazards
sections.intent: Show that the environment is just as deadly as monsters for a 1 HP build.
sections.end_condition: Artie survives a scripted rockslide using high-speed kiting.

scenes.summary: Artie navigates a narrow ledge during a windstorm.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes the wind can push him off the ledge.
scenes.transition_in_text: The wind howls through the canyons, pushing against Artie with enough force to threaten his balance.
scenes.transition_out_text: A sudden tremor shakes the mountain, and the sound of cracking stone echoes from above.

scenes.summary: A rockslide begins, and Artie must dodge falling boulders.
scenes.outcome: Artie uses 'Perfect Dodge' to avoid the rocks.
scenes.transition_in_text: A wall of stone and debris surges down the mountainside, aimed directly at the narrow path.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie leaps from rock to rock, his movements a frantic dance of survival against the crushing weight of the mountain.

scenes.summary: Transition handoff from The High Pass to The High Pass.
scenes.outcome: The handoff is concretely realized and constraints are carried forward.
scenes.transition_in_text: After a arrival checkpoint, the movement from The High Pass to The High Pass is realized on page.
scenes.transition_out_text: This beat pushes into a arrival checkpoint toward The High Pass.

scenes.summary: Artie reaches a safe cave as the rockslide settles.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie dives into a dark opening in the cliff face just as a massive boulder obliterates the path he was standing on.
scenes.transition_out_text: He leans against the damp cave wall, his heart hammering against his ribs in the sudden quiet.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie survives a scripted rockslide using high-speed kiting.

sections.title: The Gates of Oakhaven
sections.intent: Establish the next major obstacle: the social and guild-based gatekeeping.
sections.end_condition: Artie is refused entry to Oakhaven for lacking a guild voucher.

scenes.summary: Artie descends from the peaks toward Oakhaven.
scenes.outcome: Artie reaches the outskirts of the trade hub.
scenes.transition_in_text: The rugged mountains finally flatten into rolling hills as the spires of Oakhaven appear on the horizon.
scenes.transition_out_text: The road becomes crowded with merchants and travelers, all heading toward the massive iron gates.

scenes.summary: Artie attempts to enter the city.
scenes.outcome: The guards demand a guild voucher for entry.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie joins the queue at the main gate, watching as a guard in polished silver armor checks the papers of every traveler.
scenes.transition_out_text: The guard holds out a gauntleted hand, his eyes scanning Artie's unconventional attire.

scenes.summary: Artie is turned away from the gates.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he must find a way to get a voucher.
scenes.transition_in_text: The guard's voice is flat and uncompromising as he points back toward the road.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie is refused entry to Oakhaven for lacking a guild voucher.
